notes: This is an enhancement request to extend the HWAggregateToComb pass to lower `hw.union`-typed operations (muxes, union_create/union_extract), which the pass was never designed to handle — its type converter only covers arrays and structs. The pass behaves correctly for unsupported input by emitting a clean legalization error, and the maintainer explicitly confirmed on the issue that this is "not simply implemented" and invited the reporter to implement it as a new feature.
cost_provenance: cost_usd is OpenCode-reported session cost, not an AWS invoice amount
